title: ABBOTT LABORATORIES 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Abbott Laboratories filed an 8-K on April 17, 2026 disclosing that on April 10, 2026, a federal court in the Northern District of Illinois signed an order preliminarily approving a settlement in a consolidated shareholder derivative lawsuit (In re Abbott Laboratories Infant Formula Shareholder Derivative Litigation) naming certain current and former directors and officers as defendants.
key_points: The filing reports six pending shareholder derivative lawsuits consolidated into one proceeding in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Illinois
The consolidated case is titled In re Abbott Laboratories Infant Formula Shareholder Derivative Litigation
On April 10, 2026, the court signed an order preliminarily approving the proposed settlement and directing issuance of notice
A final settlement hearing date has been set; the notice of proposed settlement is filed as Exhibit 99.1
The filing was signed by Philip P. Boudreau, Executive Vice President Finance and CFO
This is an Item 8.01 'Other Events' disclosure under SEC rules
why_it_matters: This is a corporate legal matter involving shareholder derivative litigation related to infant formula. It has no relevance to monetary policy, interest rates, market structure, or macroeconomic catalysts. The filing is informational and does not disclose material financial guidance or operational changes that would impact markets.
